name: Dawn of the Damned
source:
Anxious to attend your job interview at Aurora Antiques, you arrive to discover a room full of melancholy mannequins. One, in particular, captures your interest, drawing you closer.
"Beautiful, isn't she? I can tell you her tale if you like."
"It all started with a selfish wish...":
"I'll etch your name upon my heart
So, you'll always be my lover
And if we're ever torn apart
I'll restore you with another..."

[From [url=https://melancholy-marionette.itch.io/dawnofthedamned]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你迫不及待地想参加Aurora Antiques的求职面试，抵达后却发现房间里摆满了忧郁的人偶。其中一尊尤其吸引你的目光，让你不由自主地走近。

“她很美，对吧？如果你愿意，我可以告诉你她的故事。”

“一切始于一个自私的愿望……”

“我要将你的名字刻进心底，
让你永远成为我的爱人。
倘若我们终有一日分离，
我会用另一个你，将你复原……”

[来源：[url=https://melancholy-marionette.itch.io/dawnofthedamned]Itch.io[/url]]
